metadata.label: PRECOMPUTED
metadata.note: Forecasts loaded automatically at each new pass (trigger 'observation': started from the VIIRS and Sentinel-2 burned-area observations acquired by then, the ignition point before the first) and by 'Update forecast' in between (trigger 'scheduled': started from the fire the latest observation-started forecast estimates for that time, plus anything observed since). Each uses the weather from its issue time on (archived Open-Meteo historical forecast). Contours every 30 min to 12 h; horizon 0 is the area the forecast started from. Forecasts are issued until the end of the scenario (last_issue_at); the weather data run until 2022-06-25T23:00:00Z.
